item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i gcod gdams las gshed 'dul drag po khol phyung
item.coloph: ces pa'ang gzhung gi dur gcod dmigs pa bye brag sogs dang drung mu gcod chen sogs las yin nam 'di yang shar rdza'i bya bral bkra shis rgyal mtshan nam dri med snying po la dge sbyor ba g.yung drung dpal ldan dang*/ gcung tshul khrims bstan 'dzin/ gzhan yang bstan pa la lhag par thugs brtse ba'i bu slob tshul khrims dbang phyug sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ khod po blo gros thog med kyi gter gnas sbas gnas wa (sba) zhabs brag dkar gyi ri khrod g.yung drung dge 'phel du bris pas bstan 'gro'i don chen nus par gyur cig/
